summary: Implemented a deterministic NON_AUTHORITATIVE passive operational-stats rebuilder over durable normalized evidence. The projection labels every observed field FACT, computed quantity DERIVED, and missing value UNKNOWN; derives claim/wall/fan-in latency only when timestamp pairs exist; counts retries/collisions/capability mismatch/local repairs/child yield/human round trips/post-compile corrections; deduplicates repeated evidence; separates worker incarnations by worker_id + launch_nonce; records runtime ACTIVE/PARKED-style labels only as observations and never as liveness; and reserves bounded RUN/benchmark work for causal questions. Persisted a real current-campaign evidence input and sample projection with an explicit signal/gap inventory.

tests.name: agentic_passive_operational_stats_v1

unresolved: The current real sample lacks started/returned/consumed/verified/closed timestamps, worker_model, variant, block/parent and verified outcome until those durable signals exist; projection intentionally leaves them UNKNOWN.
truth_boundary: DONE applies only to the passive analytical projection/rebuilder acceptance scope. The output is never routing, liveness, acceptance, promotion or CURRENT authority, and passive correlation is never reported as causation.
